title: Supported states
responsibility: Shows recorded screenshots for every declared visual state at the selected revision and viewport.

inputs.name: EntityStates.name
inputs.description: The readable entity name used to label the gallery.

inputs.name: EntityStates.evidence
inputs.description: Declared states and verified captures for this entity on both revision sides.

inputs.name: EntityStates.scope
inputs.description: The viewed branch tip or commit and its parent, without changing their identity.

inputs.name: EntityStates.mediaBase
inputs.description: Optional prefix for prebuilt media assets; empty when a bridge resolves images.

inputs.name: EntityStates.resolveImage
inputs.description: Optional bridge callback that returns an image URL only after validating the artifact bytes.

outputs.name: EntityStates
outputs.description: Screenshot gallery with named states, viewport selection, revision labels, explicit gaps and full-size previews.
